name: PulseQueue
one_liner: Multi-tenant workflow and approval automation for SMB operations teams.

hard_problems.title: Queue starvation from noisy-neighbor tenants
hard_problems.description: When one large tenant triggers 40,000 bulk approval notifications at month-end, interactive login and password-reset emails for other tenants stall past the 5-second SLA.

hard_problems.title: Immutable RBAC and audit log storage cost
hard_problems.description: Compliance customers require tamper-evident per-action audit trails across role-scoped approvals, which currently accounts for 65% of MySQL write IOPS and slows dashboard queries.
